jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
At OSL Retail Services, we believe people are the heart of everything we do, and it is an exciting time to be part of something special! Our momentum is growing, and is fueled by innovation, collaboration, and a shared entrepreneurial spirit that drives real results. Founded in 2012 in Mississauga, Ontario, OSL delivers customized sales solutions in retail, direct sales, and customer acquisition, all built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and passion. Our culture thrives on connection, purpose, and growth. If you’re looking for a place where your talents are valued, your ideas matter, and your career can grow, we’d love to meet you.

About the opportunity:

Director, Information Technology and Digital Transformation

OSL Retail Services is a technology-enabled sales and retail services organization supporting some of North America’s leading brands. As Director, Information Technology and Digital Transformation, you will lead the delivery and evolution of enterprise technology services that support corporate operations, field teams, client programs, analytics, and business transformation initiatives.

Reporting to the SVP, Data and Technology, you will lead a team of managers and technical leads, alongside external partners and managed service providers. You will be responsible for ensuring OSL’s technology ecosystem, including cloud platforms, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, service management, AI governance, and digital workplace services, remains secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned to business objectives.

This role is the critical bridge between the SVP’s strategic direction and day to day technology delivery, translating strategy into measurable outcomes, while maintaining a strong focus on governance, operational excellence and value realization.

Location: Mississauga

Role Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Direction

Contribute to and execute the multi-year technology strategy in partnership with the SVP, Data and Technology, translating strategic direction into delivery roadmaps, programs, and measurable outcomes.
Identify opportunities where technology, automation, analytics, and AI can improve productivity, compliance, and competitive differentiation, and bring forward business cases for prioritization.
Provide leadership and oversight for technology governance, architecture standards, and enterprise technology decision-making within the role's mandate.
Ensure technology investments are prioritized based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and strategic alignment.

Enterprise Architecture & Technology Governance

Establish and maintain technology standards, reference architectures, and governance processes across the enterprise.
Ensure technology solutions are scalable, supportable, secure, and aligned with long-term business requirements.
Oversee Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance, source code management, release management, and deployment controls.
Drive technology rationalization and reduction of technical debt through platform consolidation and modernization initiatives.
Maintain oversight of enterprise SaaS platforms and ensure effective integration across business systems.

IT Operations & Service Delivery

Oversee enterprise IT service delivery across applications, infrastructure, networks, and SaaS platforms.
Ensure systems are stable, secure, and performant to support retail, field, and corporate environments.
Establish and maintain governance for incident management, change management, and release processes.
Drive continuous improvement in service reliability, responsiveness, and user experience
Ensure technology services support a geographically distributed workforce across retail, field, and corporate environments while maintaining consistent service levels and user experience.

Digital Transformation, Automation & AI Enablement

Lead enterprise modernization initiatives including cloud adoption, platform consolidation, workflow automation, and digital workplace transformation.
Operationalize and mature OSL's established enterprise AI governance program, aligned to ISO 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, covering employee AI use, AI capabilities within SaaS platforms, and internally developed solutions.
Partner with business leaders to identify automation opportunities that improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and enhance data quality.
Deliver scalable, integrated solutions that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making, in partnership with the Business Intelligence and Data Services teams.
Balance innovation with operational resilience, cybersecurity requirements, compliance obligations, and cost management.

Financial Stewardship & Vendor Management

Manage the operational technology budget and contribute to the annual technology planning and investment prioritization led by the Executive Leadership Team.
Establish business cases and ROI measures for major technology investments and transformation programs.
Identify opportunities to optimize cost‑to‑serve through consolidation, automation, and strategic sourcing.
Manage vendor relationships, contract renewals, and licensing across the technology portfolio.

Cross Functional Partnership & Enablement

Build strong partnerships with Operations, Client Services, Finance, HR, Sales, and Analytics teams.
Act as a trusted technology advisor to business leaders, translating needs into scalable, secure solutions.
Represent IT in cross‑functional planning forums, transformation initiatives, and program reviews.
Ensuring technology decisions reflect both business value and operational reality.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, coach and develop a technology team, alongside external partners responsible for the delivery of enterprise technology services.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer service excellence.
Establish succession planning, skills development, and workforce planning strategies that support future organizational growth.
Ensure team objectives, performance measures, and priorities are aligned to corporate goals.

What You Bring to the Table

10+ years of progressive Information Technology experience, including leadership responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, or digital transformation initiatives.
5+ years in a senior leadership role managing cross-functional technology teams, including experience leading through managers or team leads.
Experience leading enterprise cloud transformation initiatives utilizing Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 platforms.
Experience operating within a regulated or compliance-driven environment, including responding to clients or external security and audit requirements.
Experience supporting ISO 27001 or comparable security and governance frameworks.
Experience managing enterprise service management platforms and ITIL-based processes.
Experience evaluating and governing emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and automation platforms.
Experience managing technology budgets and contributing to enterprise-level financial planning.
Experience supporting geographically distributed workforces across retail, field, and corporate environments.
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field or equivalent experience.

Preferred Certifications

ITIL Foundation or higher
CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent security certification
Microsoft Azure certification
ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (asset)
Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent) (asset)

Let's Talk Perks

The salary range for this role is $150K to $170K, your final compensation will reflect your years of experience and beyond the numbers, we’re proud to offer a holistic package that includes:

Generous time off: Start with 3 weeks of vacation.
Comprehensive benefits package: Includes medical, dental, vision and a health spending account.
Retirement support: Company-sponsored RRSP matching program to help build your financial future.
Award-winning culture: Proud to be one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies for 8 years running — now a Platinum Club member.
Invested in you: Structured employee development programs designed to help you thrive.

We’re committed to supporting your success every step of the way. What are the next steps?

Interview Steps:

Step 1: If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first conversation with the recruiter.
Step 2: The next step is an in-person interview with the SVP, Data and Technology.
Step 3: Final step is an in-person interview with the Chief Operating Officer.

If this sounds like you and you’re excited to be a member of our team, please apply now.

We thank all interested applicants; however, only qualified candidates will be contacted.

This position requires successful completion of a criminal background check.

Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

YOUR IMPACT

OpenText is looking for an experienced and collaborative technology leader to join our Corporate IT organization as Director, Platform Systems
. In this global leadership role, you will be responsible for the strategy, delivery, and operational excellence of critical enterprise capabilities across Integration Systems, Security and Identity Access Management, and Fulfillment Systems. You will lead distributed teams, partner with business and technology stakeholders, and help modernize the systems and practices that enable secure, scalable, and efficient business operations.

What The Role Offers

Leading and influencing in a global, matrixed environment with teams and stakeholders across multiple regions.
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, licensing decisions, and platform investments with a focus on business value, simplification, and cost effectiveness.
Work with technologies that may include Cloud Integration Hub/ICDM, SAP PI/PO, SAP Integration Suite/BTP, Boomi, MuleSoft, Google Cloud Platform, IAM platforms, licensing and fulfillment systems, APIs, automation, and observability tools.
Building trusted relationships with business partners, technology leaders, architects, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and consultants.
Communicating clearly with executive, business, technical, and operational audiences.
Bringing structure, transparency, and prioritization to complex portfolios of work.
Driving Agile ways of working, delivery predictability, team accountability, and continuous improvement.
Applying AI and automation thoughtfully to improve speed, quality, operational insight, documentation, testing, and productivity.
Balancing strategic planning with hands-on leadership in a fast-paced, business-critical environment.
Simplifying technology landscapes, reducing risk, improving resilience, and aligning work to measurable outcomes.
Promoting strong development, integration, security, identity, fulfillment, documentation, and operational practices.
Staying current on emerging trends in integration platforms, IAM, application security, fulfillment, cloud, APIs, AI, and automation.

What You Need To Succeed

10+ years of progressive experience leading application, development, enterprise systems, integration, security, identity, fulfillment, or platform teams.
Demonstrated experience leading global teams, managing multiple workstreams, and delivering business-critical technology services.
Strong technical leadership experience across enterprise integration platforms, API management, cloud integration, SAP integration technologies, IAM tools, fulfillment or licensing systems, and modern application delivery practices.
Agile training or certification is required; hands-on experience leading Agile teams, Scrum practices, backlog management, delivery metrics, and Agile maturity improvement is strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of AI capabilities and practical use cases in Integration, Security, Identity Management, and Fulfillment Systems, including automation, developer productivity, observability, testing, application security, and operational efficiency.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business language.
Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, talent development, succession planning, and building engaged teams.
Strong analytical, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment while maintaining delivery discipline, operational rigor, and stakeholder confidence.
Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, enterprise transformation, or major technology modernization initiatives is an asset.
High-tech software or enterprise software industry experience is an asset.
A relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree, college diploma, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

One Last Thing

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned.

Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.

jobs.title: Director, Talent Management & Workforce Insights
jobs.description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer and serving as a member of the HR Leadership Team, the Director, Talent Management & Workforce Insights
leads a broad enterprise portfolio spanning Total Rewards, Organizational Development, HR Operations and People Analytics. The role is accountable for the ongoing evolution of the firm's people programs, systems and enterprise HR services, ensuring they support business priorities and deliver a consistent and high-quality experience for our people.

Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition and leaders across the firm, the Director translates the firm's people strategy into practical, scalable and measurable outcomes. Through workforce insights, organizational expertise and disciplined execution, the role enables better people decisions across the firm while helping leaders strengthen organizational and business performance.

Key Accountabilities

Portfolio Leadership

Lead the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio, establishing clear priorities, accountabilities and measures of success.
Translate the firm's people strategy into firmwide initiatives, investments and outcomes that support business objectives.
Use market intelligence, workforce data and business insights to identify, inform and translate opportunities, strategies, risks and decisions into practical recommendations.
Ensure programs, systems and services operate as an integrated portfolio that delivers value for the business and our people.
Drive the ongoing evaluation and continuous improvement of enterprise people programs, policies and services.
Foster strong collaboration across HR to ensure firmwide solutions are practical, scalable and responsive to business needs.

Total Rewards, Performance & Wellbeing

Provide strategic leadership for the firm's Total Rewards portfolio, including compensation, recognition, benefits, wellbeing and performance management.
Ensure rewards programs remain competitive, sustainable and aligned with business priorities, market trends and workforce expectations.
Oversee the design and evolution of reward, recognition and performance practices that support attraction, retention, engagement and a high-performance culture.

Workforce Insights & Analytics

Advance the firm's workforce insights capability by evolving People Analytics into a strategic source of insight and decision support.
Identify workforce trends, risks and opportunities through reporting, analytics and data-driven analysis, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Strengthen workforce data governance, analytics capability and evidence-based decision-making across HR programs, workforce planning and talent strategies.

Organizational Effectiveness & Development

Lead the evolution of the firm's organizational effectiveness agenda, ensuring BDO has the leadership, organizational capabilities and workforce readiness required to support future business needs.
Partner with business leaders and HR Business Partners to strengthen leadership effectiveness, team performance, organizational design and change readiness across the firm.
Advance scalable organizational development practices that help the firm adapt to changing workforce expectations, emerging technologies and evolving business priorities.

HR Operations & Service Excellence

Provide strategic leadership for HR operations, systems and service delivery, ensuring efficient, consistent and high-quality support for employees, leaders and HR teams.
Modernize HR processes and ways of working by leveraging technology, automation and AI to improve efficiency, user experience and business outcomes.
Establish service standards, governance and performance measures that promote accountability, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Relationships & People Leadership

Build trusted relationships across the firm and serve as a strategic advisor on talent, workforce and organizational matters.
Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation.
Strengthen leadership capability, succession and organizational effectiveness across the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio.

What You Will Help Us Achieve

Success in this role means:

A connected and high-performing Talent Management portfolio that delivers measurable value to the business and our people.
Modern, competitive people programs that support attraction, retention, wellbeing and performance.
A workforce insights capability that enables stronger business, talent and workforce decisions.
Enhanced organizational effectiveness and readiness for future business challenges.
Efficient, scalable and employee-centric HR operations and services.

What You Bring

Significant senior HR leadership experience within a complex organization, including leadership of multiple enterprise talent management or centre-of-expertise functions.
Experience leading complex talent management portfolios, combined with deep expertise in one or more areas such as Total Rewards, People Analytics, organizational development, workforce planning or organizational effectiveness.
Experience leading the design, evolution or transformation of enterprise HR programs, functions or operating models.
A track record of using workforce data, analytics and organizational insights to influence business decisions and improve outcomes.
Demonstrated curiosity and innovation mindset, with evidence of challenging traditional approaches and identifying opportunities to improve employee experience, organizational effectiveness and business outcomes.
Strong understanding of emerging workforce trends and technologies, including artificial intelligence, and the ability to translate new capabilities into practical business, talent and workforce solutions.
Exceptional relationship-building, communication and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior leaders.
Demonstrated ability to align and lead diverse specialist teams, fostering collaboration, shared accountability and enterprise-wide outcomes across multiple HR disciplines.
Strong judgement and business acumen, with the ability to balance employee experience, business priorities, risk and operational realities.
Experience within professional services or another complex, relationship-driven organization would be considered a strong asset.
University degree in Human Resources, Business or a related discipline. A relevant professional designation and/or advanced degree would be considered an asset.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up:
Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter:
We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts:
We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.

Flexibility:
All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.

Code of Conduct:
Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public.

BDO may use artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. While these tools assist our teams, our use of AI does not replace human decision making, and all employment-related outcomes are made by BDO personnel.

We’re excited to share that JDRF Canada is now Breakthrough T1D.

We’re the same organization, with the same mission and determination to realize a world free from type 1 diabetes (T1D) – just with a new name and look that reflects what the T1D community needs now and next.

It’s an exciting time to join Breakthrough T1D as we continue to break barriers to help people better manage the disease and enjoy full, healthy lives. Curing T1D is and always will be our north star and we will not stop until breakthroughs get us to a world free from T1D.
Breakthrough T1D is searching for an experienced leader in Information Technology for the role of National Director, Information Technology.

If you’re a strategic, innovative and collaborative leader who would like to lead the next chapter of the organization’s digital evolution by developing and delivering a multi-year information technology strategy, roadmap and portfolio aligned with Breakthrough T1D’s strategic priorities, please read on to see if this is the right fit for you.

Here’s what your primary responsibilities would be:

Works with the Senior Leadership Team to develop and execute a multi-year IT and digital strategy, roadmap and investment portfolio aligned with organizational priorities and supported by business cases, resource plans, budgets, performance measures and clear accountabilities.
Leads Breakthrough T1D’s responsible AI strategy and portfolio, including governance, approved-use standards, privacy and security controls, vendor due diligence, human oversight, staff education, prioritized use cases and benefits measurement.
Provides planning, resourcing, oversight and accountability for the IT portfolio, including enterprise applications, infrastructure, digital platforms, data and analytics, cybersecurity, service delivery and technology-enabled innovation.
Partners with business leaders to assess needs, select solutions and oversee the design, implementation and integration of technologies that support mission delivery, research collaboration, fundraising, advocacy and organizational operations.
Develops, implements and maintains Breakthrough T1D’s cybersecurity framework, policies and controls, aligned with organizational risk, privacy and data sovereignty requirements and applicable standards.
Leads the enterprise data and analytics strategy, including data ownership, quality, classification, integration, retention, privacy, governance, reporting and the development of trusted organizational and constituent insights.
Builds, motivates and retains a highly engaged, customer-centred information technology team aligned with Breakthrough T1D’s values, vision and strategic priorities.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Knowledge/Skills/Experience
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, business technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
A minimum of seven (7) years of progressive leadership experience across information technology, digital transformation, project and portfolio management, enterprise applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and service delivery, including experience leading complex enterprise-wide initiatives and multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated experience managing IT environments with cybersecurity, privacy, and data sovereignty requirements comparable to those of federally Canadian organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise digital transformation involving cloud platforms, enterprise architecture, systems integration, digital products, vendor ecosystems and organizational change.

Working Style
Applies sound judgment, initiative and a strong sense of organization and urgency in a changing environment.
Communicates complex information clearly and credibly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, senior executives and governance bodies.
Demonstrates strong business analysis, project and financial management capabilities and a record of leading successful cross-functional initiatives.
Builds trusted relationships through a collaborative, customer-centred and business-focused approach.

Other position requirements to note:
Demonstrated experience overseeing high-volume transactional websites, CRM platforms, digital fundraising or engagement solutions, and internal collaboration and information-sharing platforms; experience with not-for-profit enterprise systems is an asset.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, data sovereignty, records and information management, accessibility, responsible AI, cyber resilience and third-party technology risk in a Canadian context.
Project, program, technology governance, security or service management certification is an asset.
Translates organizational strategy and stakeholder needs into practical technology priorities, investment decisions and outcomes.

The salary range for this role is anticipated to be $125,000 - $160,000, commensurate with skills and experience level of the selected candidate.

Location Preference:
Anywhere within Canada

Application Deadline:
Please submit your resume through our careers website by October 12, 2026.

Breakthrough T1D is the leading type 1 diabetes (T1D) research and advocacy non-profit organization in Canada. As we drive toward curing type 1 diabetes, we help to make every day better for the people who live with it.

Breakthrough T1D (formerly JDRF) began in Canada as a grassroots organization in 1974, when a group of dedicated parents came together with a singular goal of finding a cure for T1D. Benefits to support your physical and mental health – this includes Manulife group benefits, Maple virtual health care, Not Myself Today to support mentally healthy workplaces and generous paid sick time.

BIMM is a Toronto-based agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity, building high-performing digital products and connected customer experiences for clients across automotive, financial services, telco, and retail. Our technology practice has grown quickly: today it's roughly 60 people delivering close to $13M in direct technology work each year, spanning web, mobile, and backend engineering, QA, and a growing AI practice, in support of some of BIMM's most important client relationships.

Who we're looking for

BIMM is engaging a Fractional Chief Technology Officer to help shape the next phase of our technology organization. Our technology practice is scaling quickly, in size, in the breadth of what we deliver, and in the strategic weight it carries with clients, and we want experienced technology leadership to help design the structure, leadership bench, and operating model that carries us through that growth. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, working closely with BIMM's existing technology leadership team.

This is an active role with immediate impact and a clear place on the team.

Engagement:
Part-time / fractional, 2 to 3 days per week. 6-month initial term, with option to extend. We are looking for candidates (within the GTHA) that are able to work out of our beautiful office space in the Distillery District 2 days per week

In this role you will:

Shape the structure.
Partner with BIMM's CEO and technology leadership team to design an organizational structure and operating model that scales with BIMM's growth, across strategy, roadmap, presales, and delivery.
Develop leaders.
Coach and develop BIMM's existing technology leaders, building their capability and confidence to operate at the next level as the organization scales.
Strengthen partnerships.
Build a strong, senior relationship with BIMM's key technology partners, including our work with Audi RED, and help define how BIMM's architecture and delivery teams collaborate with partner organizations.
Govern initiatives & client focus.
Establish the governance and process that lets BIMM invest in its own technology initiatives while maintaining focus on clients, spanning web, mobile, AI, and emerging technology.
Support growth.
Provide senior technical leadership on new business pitches, proposals, and client opportunities.
Shape what's next.
Partner with BIMM's CEO on what long-term technology leadership should look like as the organization continues to scale.

Success in the first 90 days:

A clear view of BIMM's technology organization, its strengths, and where structure needs to evolve to support growth.
A proposed organizational and operating model, developed in partnership with the CEO and current leadership team.
Regular working sessions established with BIMM's technology leaders.

Success in the first 6 months:

New structure and ways of working in motion.
A sustainable model in place for balancing strategy, roadmap, presales, and delivery across a growing team.
A strong, senior relationship established with BIMM's key technology partners.
A clear recommendation delivered to the CEO on BIMM's long-term technology leadership needs.

Requirements

Extensive experience leading technology organizations, ideally within an agency, consultancy, or professional services environment.
Experience leading global teams that blend local, nearshore, and offshore resourcing, and able to advise on evolving BIMM's own model.
Experience operating in a fractional, interim, or advisory capacity.
A strong track record managing complex client and partner relationships, including joint venture or embedded delivery models; automotive experience is an asset.
A leader who develops people as much as technology, comfortable coaching and building senior teams.
Broad technical credibility across web, mobile, AI, QA, and architecture (BIMM's core stack includes React, Node.js, native Swift, and Kotlin Multiplatform).
Comfortable operating at the executive table and directly with clients and partners.

Even if you don’t meet all of the above requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

What’s in it for you?

Culture: Our squad is fun, friendly and entirely egoless. Our social committee plans BIMM bashes, Tasty Thursdays and quarterly outings like candle making workshops, board game nights, Jays games and cooking classes. Our summer and holiday parties are quite memorable as well! Having Fun Everyday is one of our core values.
Belonging: Our dedicated DEI committee provides thought-provoking insights which are reflected in our work; They also organize engaging awareness activities and events to showcase BIMMER’s professional talents and personalities. What talents might you bring? :)
Growth: BIMM is part of kyu collective which gives our employees access to the network’s resources, training, offices, and more. We also prioritize your personal and professional development with opportunities like on-site Lunch n’ Learns, conferences and online courses. Love 2 Learn.

BIMM is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all applicants for employment without discrimination. Please let us know if accommodation for the recruitment or interview process is required, and we will work with you to make sure your needs are met.

AI in Recruitment

While we are exploring ways to best utilize AI in our hiring processes, BIMM currently does not use AI-enabled tools in our hiring process. All candidates are screened by humans, and approved by humans.

Company Description
PORTA – Tradizione Italiana is one of North America’s fastest-growing frozen pizza brands, bringing authentic Italian craftsmanship to over 3,000 retail locations across the U.S. and Canada. Developed by the culinary team behind Terroni, PORTA combines chef-curated recipes with premium ingredients sourced from Italy to elevate frozen food standards. Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer and serving as a member of the HR Leadership Team, the Director, Talent Management & Workforce Insights
leads a broad enterprise portfolio spanning Total Rewards, Organizational Development, HR Operations and People Analytics. The role is accountable for the ongoing evolution of the firm's people programs, systems and enterprise HR services, ensuring they support business priorities and deliver a consistent and high-quality experience for our people.

Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition and leaders across the firm, the Director translates the firm's people strategy into practical, scalable and measurable outcomes. Through workforce insights, organizational expertise and disciplined execution, the role enables better people decisions across the firm while helping leaders strengthen organizational and business performance.

Key Accountabilities

Portfolio Leadership

Lead the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio, establishing clear priorities, accountabilities and measures of success.
Translate the firm's people strategy into firmwide initiatives, investments and outcomes that support business objectives.
Use market intelligence, workforce data and business insights to identify, inform and translate opportunities, strategies, risks and decisions into practical recommendations.
Ensure programs, systems and services operate as an integrated portfolio that delivers value for the business and our people.
Drive the ongoing evaluation and continuous improvement of enterprise people programs, policies and services.
Foster strong collaboration across HR to ensure firmwide solutions are practical, scalable and responsive to business needs.

Total Rewards, Performance & Wellbeing

Provide strategic leadership for the firm's Total Rewards portfolio, including compensation, recognition, benefits, wellbeing and performance management.
Ensure rewards programs remain competitive, sustainable and aligned with business priorities, market trends and workforce expectations.
Oversee the design and evolution of reward, recognition and performance practices that support attraction, retention, engagement and a high-performance culture.

Workforce Insights & Analytics

Advance the firm's workforce insights capability by evolving People Analytics into a strategic source of insight and decision support.
Identify workforce trends, risks and opportunities through reporting, analytics and data-driven analysis, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Strengthen workforce data governance, analytics capability and evidence-based decision-making across HR programs, workforce planning and talent strategies.

Organizational Effectiveness & Development

Lead the evolution of the firm's organizational effectiveness agenda, ensuring BDO has the leadership, organizational capabilities and workforce readiness required to support future business needs.
Partner with business leaders and HR Business Partners to strengthen leadership effectiveness, team performance, organizational design and change readiness across the firm.
Advance scalable organizational development practices that help the firm adapt to changing workforce expectations, emerging technologies and evolving business priorities.

HR Operations & Service Excellence

Provide strategic leadership for HR operations, systems and service delivery, ensuring efficient, consistent and high-quality support for employees, leaders and HR teams.
Modernize HR processes and ways of working by leveraging technology, automation and AI to improve efficiency, user experience and business outcomes.
Establish service standards, governance and performance measures that promote accountability, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Relationships & People Leadership

Build trusted relationships across the firm and serve as a strategic advisor on talent, workforce and organizational matters.
Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation.
Strengthen leadership capability, succession and organizational effectiveness across the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio.

What You Will Help Us Achieve

Success in this role means:

A connected and high-performing Talent Management portfolio that delivers measurable value to the business and our people.
Modern, competitive people programs that support attraction, retention, wellbeing and performance.
A workforce insights capability that enables stronger business, talent and workforce decisions.
Enhanced organizational effectiveness and readiness for future business challenges.
Efficient, scalable and employee-centric HR operations and services.

What You Bring

Significant senior HR leadership experience within a complex organization, including leadership of multiple enterprise talent management or centre-of-expertise functions.
Experience leading complex talent management portfolios, combined with deep expertise in one or more areas such as Total Rewards, People Analytics, organizational development, workforce planning or organizational effectiveness.
Experience leading the design, evolution or transformation of enterprise HR programs, functions or operating models.
A track record of using workforce data, analytics and organizational insights to influence business decisions and improve outcomes.
Demonstrated curiosity and innovation mindset, with evidence of challenging traditional approaches and identifying opportunities to improve employee experience, organizational effectiveness and business outcomes.
Strong understanding of emerging workforce trends and technologies, including artificial intelligence, and the ability to translate new capabilities into practical business, talent and workforce solutions.
Exceptional relationship-building, communication and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior leaders.
Demonstrated ability to align and lead diverse specialist teams, fostering collaboration, shared accountability and enterprise-wide outcomes across multiple HR disciplines.
Strong judgement and business acumen, with the ability to balance employee experience, business priorities, risk and operational realities.
Experience within professional services or another complex, relationship-driven organization would be considered a strong asset.
University degree in Human Resources, Business or a related discipline. A relevant professional designation and/or advanced degree would be considered an asset.

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up:
Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts:
We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.

Flexibility:
All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.

Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public.

new_jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (Part-Time/Fractional)
new_jobs.description:
BIMM is a Toronto-based agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity, building high-performing digital products and connected customer experiences for clients across automotive, financial services, telco, and retail. Our technology practice has grown quickly: today it's roughly 60 people delivering close to $13M in direct technology work each year, spanning web, mobile, and backend engineering, QA, and a growing AI practice, in support of some of BIMM's most important client relationships.

Who we're looking for

BIMM is engaging a Fractional Chief Technology Officer to help shape the next phase of our technology organization. Our technology practice is scaling quickly, in size, in the breadth of what we deliver, and in the strategic weight it carries with clients, and we want experienced technology leadership to help design the structure, leadership bench, and operating model that carries us through that growth. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, working closely with BIMM's existing technology leadership team.

This is an active role with immediate impact and a clear place on the team.

Engagement:
Part-time / fractional, 2 to 3 days per week. 6-month initial term, with option to extend. We are looking for candidates (within the GTHA) that are able to work out of our beautiful office space in the Distillery District 2 days per week

In this role you will:

Shape the structure.
Partner with BIMM's CEO and technology leadership team to design an organizational structure and operating model that scales with BIMM's growth, across strategy, roadmap, presales, and delivery.
Develop leaders.
Coach and develop BIMM's existing technology leaders, building their capability and confidence to operate at the next level as the organization scales.
Strengthen partnerships.
Build a strong, senior relationship with BIMM's key technology partners, including our work with Audi RED, and help define how BIMM's architecture and delivery teams collaborate with partner organizations.
Govern initiatives & client focus.
Establish the governance and process that lets BIMM invest in its own technology initiatives while maintaining focus on clients, spanning web, mobile, AI, and emerging technology.
Support growth.
Provide senior technical leadership on new business pitches, proposals, and client opportunities.
Shape what's next.
Partner with BIMM's CEO on what long-term technology leadership should look like as the organization continues to scale.

Success in the first 90 days:

A clear view of BIMM's technology organization, its strengths, and where structure needs to evolve to support growth.
A proposed organizational and operating model, developed in partnership with the CEO and current leadership team.
Regular working sessions established with BIMM's technology leaders.

Success in the first 6 months:

New structure and ways of working in motion.
A sustainable model in place for balancing strategy, roadmap, presales, and delivery across a growing team.
A strong, senior relationship established with BIMM's key technology partners.
A clear recommendation delivered to the CEO on BIMM's long-term technology leadership needs.

Requirements

Extensive experience leading technology organizations, ideally within an agency, consultancy, or professional services environment.
Experience leading global teams that blend local, nearshore, and offshore resourcing, and able to advise on evolving BIMM's own model.
Experience operating in a fractional, interim, or advisory capacity.
A strong track record managing complex client and partner relationships, including joint venture or embedded delivery models; automotive experience is an asset.
A leader who develops people as much as technology, comfortable coaching and building senior teams.
Broad technical credibility across web, mobile, AI, QA, and architecture (BIMM's core stack includes React, Node.js, native Swift, and Kotlin Multiplatform).
Comfortable operating at the executive table and directly with clients and partners.

Even if you don’t meet all of the above requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

What’s in it for you?

Culture: Our squad is fun, friendly and entirely egoless. Our social committee plans BIMM bashes, Tasty Thursdays and quarterly outings like candle making workshops, board game nights, Jays games and cooking classes. Our summer and holiday parties are quite memorable as well! Having Fun Everyday is one of our core values.
Belonging: Our dedicated DEI committee provides thought-provoking insights which are reflected in our work; They also organize engaging awareness activities and events to showcase BIMMER’s professional talents and personalities. What talents might you bring? :)
Growth: BIMM is part of kyu collective which gives our employees access to the network’s resources, training, offices, and more. We also prioritize your personal and professional development with opportunities like on-site Lunch n’ Learns, conferences and online courses. Love 2 Learn.

BIMM is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all applicants for employment without discrimination. Please let us know if accommodation for the recruitment or interview process is required, and we will work with you to make sure your needs are met.

AI in Recruitment

While we are exploring ways to best utilize AI in our hiring processes, BIMM currently does not use AI-enabled tools in our hiring process. All candidates are screened by humans, and approved by humans.
